forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: 'Inkling 2 MTP: cheaper verify rows (shared projection weight reads)'
+---
+An Inkling 2 verify pass runs its rows through the decode kernels (^04yn8q4). For bit-exact rows the projections and lm_head run one MLX qmv per row through a non-contiguous `[L, 1, D]` view, so each row re-reads the weights: `MultiRowQuantizedMatvec` (which reads weights once and matches `qmv_fast`) does not run for K = 2304 (2304 % 512 != 0, MLX runs the generic `qmv` there). Measured on the M5 (short context): decode 13.5 ms, verify L=2 13.0 ms, L=4 17.9 ms, L=8 28.4 ms; the per-row cost (~2.5 ms) is mostly expert weight bandwidth, the rest projection/lm_head re-reads.
+
+Extend the bit-exact multi-row matvec to the generic `qmv` layout (K not a multiple of 512) and use it for the Inkling verify rows; also consider an Inkling default block size of 3 (fastest measured: 1.13x prose, 1.44x code vs 1.02x/1.37x at the shared default 4).
+
+#inkling
\ No newline at end of file

--- original

@@ -1,6 +1,31 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m81xphs1dsehbw4f8zzzgdkv
+  text: |-
+    Done in 399bec05, 0ad3b7ea (review fixes), 819c4673 (IntegrationTesting optional-block fix).
+
+    What changed
+    - MultiRowQuantizedMatvec reproduces MLX's generic `qmv`/`fp_qmv` as well as `qmv_fast` (`MatvecLayout` .fast = 2 packs/lane, .generic = 1 pack/lane; picked by input width like MLX). Inkling's K=2304 4-bit layers now run the bit-exact multi-row kernel. New tests: every format/dtype/threadgroup width in the generic layout bit-identical to the per-row matvec; layout selection.
+    - Inkling2 verify rows run attention projections (fused q/k/v/r/gate/sink and k/v+conv taps), o_proj and lm_head through `rowwiseProjection` (multi-row kernel for 3–8 rows, else one matvec per row as before).
+    - `MTPDrafterModel.preferredBlockSize` (default nil). Block size is now `Int?`/nil-by-default in SpeculativeDecodingConfig, MLXSpeculativeDecoding, generate/generateTask/generateTokens and MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator; `SpeculativeDecodingConfig.mtpBlockSize(_:for:)` (public) resolves requested ?? drafter preferred ?? defaultMTPBlockSize (4). Inkling2DraftModel prefers 3, so a Router that sets no block size (FoundationModelsExtras MLXModelLoader builds MLXSpeculativeDecoding without one) gets 3; Qwen etc. keep 4.
+
+    Review findings (all resolved, 0ad3b7ea; re-review clean): missing doc on default preferredBlockSize; magic numbers (packs per lane); function length of header (split into header(_:) + sharedHeader); kernel dictionaries duplicated (makeKernels); Inkling2Attention key/value projection duplication (convolvedProjection); test duplication (assertEveryFormatAndDtypeMatches takes a width per bits); PreferredBlockDrafter duplicated ConfigTestMTPDrafter (merged).
+
+    Measurements (M5, Release, shared GPU with a concurrent SWE-bench, so pairs alternate A=before 8cba0cfa, B=after):
+    - Round-cost profile, short context, ms (A/B per pair):
+      decode L=1: 18.37/17.19, 16.78/17.12, 17.10/17.35, 17.21/17.41 (median 17.16→17.27, flat)
+      verify L=2: 18.26/15.44, 18.09/17.97, 18.60/18.18, 19.17/17.85 (L=2 keeps per-row matvec)
+      verify L=4: 23.54/22.66, 23.65/23.07, 23.66/22.90, 23.80/22.67 (median 23.66→22.79, −3.7%, B faster 4/4)
+      verify L=8: 36.41/33.93, 36.14/33.88, 36.73/33.91, 36.41/33.94 (median 36.41→33.92, −6.8%, B faster 4/4)
+    - Throughput pairs (tok/s, A/B; noise from the concurrent bench dominates): plain short 63.3/62.1, 75.7/45.8, 60.9/57.0; plain long(5077 tok) 60.4/60.0, 73.2/49.4, 60.0/56.4; MTP block 3 short 65.5/75.7, 91.1/48.4, 72.9/66.7; block 3 long 90.5/82.4, 109.0/88.2, 85.9/88.7; block 4 short 66.8/69.1, 81.6/60.6, 66.4/71.1; block 4 long 87.8/90.7, 98.0/88.0, 82.3/85.5. Token sequences/acceptance identical A vs B (bit-exact).
+    - Block choice: full sweep in one run (D): short b3..b8 71.9/66.9/60.5/54.1/50.7/46.7, long 80.1/77.4/70.5/62.7/61.8/57.7 tok/s; block 3 fastest at both contexts. Kept preferredBlockSize = 3.
+    Decision: keep both (verify rows ≥3 cheaper with no decode cost; no adaptive guard).
+
+    Tests: all 5 bundles green on final code (MLXLMTests 2567, Guided 86, FoundationModels 570, CXGrammar 7, Macros 11); Inkling2MTPIntegrationTests (incl. chat session with no block size → preferred block 3, prompt cache reused: turn 1 cached 248, turn 2 cached 331, MTP text == plain), Inkling2CheckpointIntegrationTests, Inkling2ToolLoopIntegrationTests pass.
+  timestamp: 2026-11-22T15:23:51.969761+00:00
 position_column: doing
 position_ordinal: '80'
 title: 'Inkling 2 MTP: cheaper verify rows (shared projection weight reads)'
